name: Accelerated Adjoint Queries for Barnes-Hut
definition: A two-stage backpropagation scheme to compute derivatives of per-point attributes through the Barnes-Hut tree with logarithmic complexity, avoiding the linear complexity of naive automatic differentiation.
summary: Accelerated Adjoint Queries computes Barnes-Hut tree derivatives in logarithmic time by decoupling gradient accumulation from propagation, enabling spatial pruning during backpropagation.
